title: Input Quality
hook: Bad leads don't polish up. I spent a year trying.
statement: Junk in, junk out. Process won't save bad inputs.
explainer: Great process plus bad leads still equals mediocre. Fix what goes in first.
sop: Cut or upgrade the weakest input.
equation_example: Input 4 × Process 9 = 36. Elite process, weak material, stuck in the 30s.
question: Write down one bad input. Cut it this week.
closing_statement: No process fixes a broken input.
